ops.quote: An effective feature representation should be robust to illumination and viewpoint changes
we apply the Retinex transform and a scale invariant texture operator
LOMO feature analyzes the horizontal occurrence of local features
maximizes the occurrence to make a stable representation against viewpoint changes
learn a discriminant low dimensional subspace by cross-view quadratic discrimin,
simultaneously, a QDA metric is learned on the derived subspace
we propose to learn a discriminant low dimensional subspace by cross-view quadratic discriminant analysis
we also present a practical computation method for XQDA, as well as its regularization
